breakthroughs.insight: She was dead by 00:50 at the latest, but her voice went out at 01:10. Whatever aired at 01:10 was not live.
The 01:10 link wished listeners a happy Easter weekend on 6 March. It was one of the pre-recorded Easter voice tracks.
The Easter voice track was scheduled at 00:44 under Marguerite's login, while her badge shows her inside the building from 00:22 to 00:52.
Marguerite says she left at 23:30 and never came back. Her badge came back in at 00:22 and left at 00:52, right across the time of death. Her 01:12 petrol receipt only covers the fake 01:10 link.
Lena's badge went out at 00:24, before the earliest time of death. Her story holds so far.
The 'ad verification fee' on every sponsor invoice went to MV Media Solutions, a company whose sole director is Marguerite Vos.
The guard saw a white Polo, the car Marguerite left in, parked in the staff lane from 00:20 until about 00:54.

revealLines.text: …Fine. She asked me about the Rooibos numbers on Thursday. I told her it was a system error. That's all it was. She kept notes on everything, you know. In that folder of hers.
Okay. I went out to cool off. A ride to Sea Point, The Blue Fin on Main Road, until about half past one. I can show you the receipts.
All right, I wasn't smoking. I sat in Mama Rosa's café on a call with a recruiter. I didn't want Thandi to know I was looking.
I… came back for some papers I'd left. Ten minutes, maybe. I didn't see Thandi. I didn't go near Studio B.

debrief.text: Thandi asks Marguerite about the Rooibos & Co numbers. Marguerite calls it a billing error.
Before leaving, Marguerite sees Thandi's note in the show folder: 'Ask M on Monday or go to the board.'
Marguerite comes back through the side door after Thandi refuses to talk by text.
During "Long Song", Marguerite confronts Thandi in Studio B and strikes her with the award plaque. Thandi's watch records her last pulse at 00:35.
Marguerite loads an auto-playlist, then schedules one of Thandi's pre-recorded Easter voice tracks to play at 01:10, so Thandi will seem alive.
She wipes the plaque, pulls the blinds and leaves by the side door.
The voice track airs: 'Happy Easter weekend, Cape Town!' Listeners laugh. It is the line that undoes her.
Marguerite buys petrol in Sea Point to give herself an alibi for 01:10.
